prerequisites: Prior knowledge of the Graphic Expression course is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Interpret and represent plans of Engineering structures and installations.
Correctly use specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards for the graphic representation of industrial installations.
Customize CAD applications oriented to specific installations and drawings.
Organize and manage CAD systems in companies.
Exchange drawing files between applications and via the Internet.

syllabus_topics: Software CAD / BIM / MEP / Visualization / Animation / Simulation.
BIM Systems. Parametric modeling of structures and architecture.
Scientific visualization. Animation and Simulation of 3D models.
Exchange of drawing files between different computer applications.
Principles of dimensioning applied to industrial installations. Standards.

assessment_methods.method: Exercises, work and/or presentations developed during the course (Individual project and oral presentation)
Active participation of the student in the development of the subject. Correct completion of the proposed exercises during the course.

assessment_rules: Students must attend at least 80% of practical classes (Classroom and Laboratory) to be considered for continuous evaluation. The final grade is calculated as 0.75 * EV2 + 0.25 * EV4. If minimums are not met, the grade will be the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. For extraordinary evaluation, students must resubmit a personal project, corrected or new.
